video.agentToolHint: Offers the agent video_generate and video_status while a video provider is configured. It asks before each generation; choose Allow always in the approval to stop asking.
video.description: Defaults for videos generated from chat — by the agent or with /video. A single request can override any of them.
video.modelNeedsImage: This model animates an image: stage one with /video, or the agent uses one from the conversation.
video.modelTextOnly: This model generates from text only and does not take a start image.
video.noProvidersHint: Add Google (Veo), xAI, fal, Replicate, Volcengine / Doubao (Seedance) or Qwen (Wan) with an API key under AI connections.
video.optionsNeedProvider: Pick a provider to set its default duration, aspect ratio and resolution.
video.savedProviderGone: {provider} is no longer configured. Chat videos use the first configured provider until you pick another.
video.title: Video
video.webNote: In the browser only Google Veo can be reached. The desktop and mobile apps reach every provider.
